title: Halting the march of the African armyworm: a natural cure offers hope to farmers

paragraphs.en: Hearing about fields full of dead caterpillars enveloped in a mysterious white substance intrigued the South African scientist Letodi Luki Mathulwe. Something was killing off the African armyworm – one of the most devastating pests for farmers in east and southern Africa.
paragraphs.zh: 听说田地里满是裹着一层神秘白色物质的死毛虫，这让南非科学家莱托迪·卢基·马图尔维（Letodi Luki Mathulwe）产生了浓厚兴趣。有某种东西正在杀死非洲粘虫——这种害虫对东非和南部非洲的农民来说是最具破坏性的害虫之一。

paragraphs.en: The white substance was a naturally occurring fungus and it was wiping out the caterpillar, which gained its name from its march-like advance through fields of crops.
paragraphs.zh: 那层白色物质是一种天然存在的真菌，它正在消灭这种毛虫。非洲粘虫之所以得名，是因为它们会像军队行军一样在庄稼地里成群推进。

paragraphs.en: An outbreak of African armyworm ( Spodoptera exempta ) in 2025 had started in northern South Africa and by April had reached the eastern province of KwaZulu-Natal, where Mathulwe was working for the agriculture department. Every day she was getting panicked calls from local farmers who were finding the caterpillars in their fields.
paragraphs.zh: 2025年爆发的非洲粘虫（Spodoptera exempta，学名：草地贪夜蛾）灾情从南非北部开始，到4月已蔓延至东部夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省，马图尔维当时正在该省的农业部门工作。每天她都会接到当地农民惊慌失措的电话，他们在地里发现了这种毛虫。

paragraphs.en: Mathulwe went out to the KwaZulu-Natal countryside to see for herself and it was there, in the fields of Kikuyu grass – crucial grazing for livestock – that she realised she had made an important discovery.
paragraphs.zh: 马图尔维亲自前往夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省的乡村查看，正是在那里，在基库尤草（牲畜至关重要的牧草）的田地里，她意识到自己有了一个重要发现。

paragraphs.en: “Something was killing the insects naturally. I was intrigued because in other areas the insects were alive and destroying the grass but as soon as they come here, there’s something that is killing them,” she said.
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“有某种东西在自然杀死这些昆虫。我很好奇，因为其他地方的昆虫还活着并破坏着牧草，但一旦它们来到这里，就有某种东西在杀死它们。”

paragraphs.en: As an entomologist who had studied the use of fungi to kill insect pests, Mathulwe immediately gathered samples of the dead armyworms and the fungus to test at her laboratory in Pietermaritzburg.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一名研究用真菌消灭害虫的昆虫学家，马图尔维立即收集了死粘虫和真菌的样本，带回她在彼得马里茨堡的实验室进行检测。

paragraphs.en: Her team’s results , now presented in a peer-reviewed research paper , showed she was right in her hunch that the fungus could be used in the fight against the armyworms.
paragraphs.zh: 她团队的实验结果现已发表在同行评审的研究论文中，表明她认为真菌可用于对抗粘虫的直觉是正确的。

paragraphs.en: It was a major breakthrough, said Mathulwe, because while there are chemical treatments for dealing with the caterpillars in the early stages of life, nothing has proven effective against mature populations.
paragraphs.zh: 马图尔维说，这是一项重大突破，因为虽然有化学处理方法可以对付幼虫早期的粘虫，但迄今没有任何方法被证明能有效对付成年虫群。
